info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Party Routing Profile Management API
info.description: This API enables the dynamic management of party routing profiles, allowing businesses to adjust routing parameters based on evolving needs. Users can modify existing profiles to enhance transaction processing, improve operational efficiency, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Typical consumers include financial institutions and service providers who need to tailor routing strategies for different party interactions. The endpoint supports updates to specified routing profiles identified by unique parameters, facilitating quick adjustments in a fast-paced environment.

patch.description: Allows for the modification of an existing party routing profile identified by its unique ID. This operation enables you to update various attributes of the routing profile to meet evolving business requirements.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the routing profile of a specific party identified by PARTY-600045. It requires details of the attributes that need to be modified, ensuring the current configurations are updated accordingly.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
